scope: UI header/navigation/presentation only; no backend change
contract: Header left is the current function name (Inbox, Projects, Tags, Flagged, History or exact saved Perspective name). A floating navigation menu replaces sidebar and mobile view select.

Navigation menu contains the five functions and saved Perspectives, with selected state, icons, keyboard Arrow/Home/End navigation, Enter activation, Escape/outside close and initiating-button focus restoration. No duplicated sidebar/select remains.
Display options is one compact header dropdown. Relevant Defer choices and History status choices retain exact existing filters and per-view memory. Fullscreen host toggle remains unchanged.
Refresh is icon-only with accessible label and tooltip.

Add Action retains current contextual target and disabled reason. Add Project/Tag switches to the corresponding tree view, then shows its inline creation input. Invocation target kind/root-or-child parent is captured before navigation; existing submission guards prevent unknown recovery from replacing newer navigation or raw input.
Navigation flushes ordinary proposals and preserves IME/unknown recovery. No Review or Save controls are introduced.
Header remains sticky and responsive, with overlays inside viewport in light/dark and narrow/full modes. New two-column shell uses the full freed sidebar width; selected inspector remains contextual.
All previous geometric gutter/center-left native drag, occurrence selection, calendar and autosave contracts remain unchanged.
verification: No sidebar/mobile scope select; current-name heading and single navigation entry point.
Keyboard/Escape/outside menus and focused inspector header reachability at320/390/1280 light/dark.
Exact existing filter/proposal/IME/unknown preservation across new navigation controls.
Add Project/Tag from Inbox and other pages shows matching tree and inline input before any write; later submission/navigation retains exact identity/version guards.
Trusted native last-child left-gutter root outdent after changed shell geometry.
